dedupe_keys.name: suitable areas for wind farm construction in china key data and feature analysis

description: Wei Song and Xuyang Zhang publish wind-farm suitability information for China using physical-geographic and socioeconomic inputs. The free Zenodo ZIP carries CC BY 4.0. The description documents exclusion layers, weighted suitability scores and provincial summaries for 2020, using wind, terrain, settlement and transmission-distance factors. Wind inputs have one-kilometre resolution and are extrapolated from ten to one hundred metres under stated profile assumptions. These layers can constrain renewable siting scenarios in infrastructure-expansion simulations. Related catalogue data-openstreetmap supplies some upstream transport and transmission features, without explicitly covering this derived assessment. Coverage is national screening, not engineering approval for individual sites. The provider identifies missing land ownership, social acceptance and future wind-climate effects. Internal encodings, exact weighting reproducibility and suitability accuracy remain unverified. No archive was downloaded or area totals recalculated.
